home.aboutTitle: One agent who knows the island
home.aboutBody: Susana Rodrigo came to Ibiza from San Sebastián in 1999. After years at The Key, Ibiza, she founded La Casa de Susana in 2010 to work the way she likes best: personally, with fewer clients and closer attention, from the first viewing to the notary.
home.aboutBody2: Nine in ten of her listings are managed directly with the owner. When a client needs something she doesn't have, she works with trusted partner agencies — and her network of banks, lawyers and specialists keeps every negotiation formal and discreet.

about.metaTitle: Susana Rodrigo — Ibiza real estate agent since 2010
about.metaDescription: Susana Rodrigo has lived in Ibiza since 1999 and founded La Casa de Susana in 2010. A personal, founder-led agency for buying, renting and selling in Ibiza.
about.title: Susana Rodrigo
about.lede: From San Sebastián, on Ibiza since 1999.
about.p1: Susana arrived on the island in 1999 and spent her first years in real estate at The Key, Ibiza. In 2010 she set up on her own with a simple idea: a more personal way of buying, selling and renting homes on the island.
about.p2: La Casa de Susana works with a deliberately short list of clients. Around 90% of the properties she offers are managed directly with their owners, and when a client needs something she doesn't have, she works with experienced partner agencies rather than letting the search stop.
about.p3: Over the years she has built a network of banks, law firms and specialists across every relevant sector, so negotiations stay formal, discreet and well advised from the first viewing to the notary.
